First public release of the StatHubs connector for Magento 2.

## Highlights
- Connect your shop to the StatHubs app by scanning a QR code under **System → StatHubs**.
- Creates a dedicated, read-only API user: orders and store configuration only. That user cannot sign in to the admin.
- Works with Magento two-factor authentication enabled. Only the StatHubs user gets a token without an authenticator app.

## Compatibility
- Tested on Mage-OS 3.6.0 (`magento/framework` 103.0.9) with PHP 8.3.
- Requires Magento Open Source / Adobe Commerce 2.4.4 or later and PHP 8.1 or later.

## Download
- `stathubs-magento2.zip`: the module

## Installation
Installation requires shell access. The Magento 2.4 admin cannot install extensions from a ZIP. Follow the steps in the [README](../../blob/v1.0.0/README.md#installation).
